concepts.title: DRAM Row Buffer
concepts.summary: Reading a DRAM cell destroys it, so a whole row is latched into a buffer. Access cost depends on history.

concepts.title: Compilers and interpreters
concepts.summary: The split is when translation happens, not which language you use. Bytecode, VMs and JIT follow from that.

concepts.title: Vim's editing grammar
concepts.summary: Vim commands compose from operators and nouns, so most were never designed individually.
